title: A REST CRUD API
summary: Build create, read, update and delete routes for one resource, stored in an in-memory array.

docs.title: Express 5 API: app.delete and the other method helpers

quiz.q: In a REST API, which method and path would you use to read one item with id 3?
quiz.explain: REST puts the thing (a noun like `todos`) in the path and the action in the HTTP method. GET reads.

quiz.q: Put the lines in order to build the route that creates an item.
lines: const item = { id: nextId++, title: req.body.title, done: false };
quiz.explain: Build the new object, store it in the array, then answer with 201 and the stored object.

quiz.q: Match each action to its HTTP method.
quiz.explain: CRUD stands for Create (POST), Read (GET), Update (PUT or PATCH) and Delete (DELETE). PUT replaces the whole item and PATCH changes only some fields.

quiz.q: The array holds ids 1, 2 and 3. After this route runs for `DELETE /todos/2`, what does `todos.map(t => t.id).join(',')` give?
quiz.explain: `filter` keeps every item whose id is not 2, so ids 1 and 3 remain.

quiz.q: Click the line with the mistake. The route should add an item with a unique id each time.
quiz.explain: `nextId` is never increased, so every item would get id 1. Use `id: nextId++` or add `nextId++` after building the object.

exercise.task:
Finish the todos API in `app.js`. The `todos` array, `nextId` and `express.json()` are ready.

- `GET /todos` sends all todos as JSON.
- `GET /todos/:id` sends the item with that id.
- `POST /todos` takes `{ "title": "..." }`, adds `{ id, title, done: false }` using `nextId`, and answers with status `201` and the new item.
- `PUT /todos/:id` takes `{ "title": "...", "done": true }`, updates that item, and sends the updated item.
- `DELETE /todos/:id` removes that item and answers with status `204`.

Ignore missing ids for now, the next lesson handles them. Leave `module.exports = app;` at the bottom.
hints: Each route needs `app.get`, `app.post`, `app.put` or `app.delete` with the right path. For the routes with `:id`, find the item with `todos.find((t) => t.id === Number(req.params.id))`.

POST: build `{ id: nextId++, title: req.body.title, done: false }`, push it and send it with `res.status(201).json(item)`. PUT: set `item.title` and `item.done` from `req.body`. DELETE: reassign `todos = todos.filter(...)` and call `res.sendStatus(204)`.
